title: Actions
description: Every microterm action with its default keybinding on macOS and Linux.

<!-- Generated by `cargo run -p xtask -- gen-docs` from the action registry. Do not edit. -->

Every action can be run from the [command palette](/docs/command-palette-and-launcher/) and bound under `[[keys]]` in the config. Actions that take an argument are written as a table:

```toml
[[keys]]
key = "cmd+shift+h"
action = { SpawnCommand = { command = ["htop"], cwd = "~" } }

[[keys]]
key = "cmd+shift+k"
action = "Disable"   # unbind a default
```

## Tabs & windows

| Action | Description | macOS | Linux |
|---|---|---|---|
| `SpawnTab` | **New tab** — Open a new tab | `⌘T` | `Ctrl+Shift+T` |
| `CloseTab` | **Close tab** — Close the active tab | `⌘W` | `Ctrl+Shift+W` |
| `ActivateTabRelative(1)` | **Next tab** — Switch to the next tab | `⌘⇧]` | `Ctrl+Tab` |
| `ActivateTabRelative(-1)` | **Previous tab** — Switch to the previous tab | `⌘⇧[` | `Ctrl+Shift+Tab` |
| `MoveTabRelative(-1)` | **Move tab left** — Move the active tab one position left | — | — |
| `MoveTabRelative(1)` | **Move tab right** — Move the active tab one position right | — | — |
| `RenameTab` | **Rename tab** — Edit the active tab's title | — | — |
| `CloseWindow` | **Close window** — Close the window and all its tabs | — | — |
| `SpawnWindow` | **New window** — Open a new window | `⌘N` | `Ctrl+Shift+N` |
| `ToggleFullscreen` | **Toggle fullscreen** — Enter or leave fullscreen | — | — |
| `Minimize` | **Minimize** — Minimize the window | `⌘M` | — |
| `ZoomWindow` | **Zoom** — Zoom the window | — | — |
| `HideApp` | **Hide microterm** — Hide the application | `⌘H` | — |
| `HideOthers` | **Hide others** — Hide every other application | `⌘⌥H` | — |
| `ShowAllApps` | **Show all** — Show every hidden application | — | — |
| `BringAllToFront` | **Bring all to front** — Raise every microterm window | — | — |
| `ActivateTab` | **Go to tab** — Activate tab N (counting from 1); bound to ⌘1–⌘9 on macOS and Alt+1–Alt+9 on Linux | — | — |
| `SpawnTabInDomain` | **New tab in domain** — Open a tab in the named domain (`local`, or an SSH domain once M10 lands) | — | — |

## Panes

| Action | Description | macOS | Linux |
|---|---|---|---|
| `SplitHorizontal` | **Split pane right** — Split the focused pane into two side by side | `⌘D` | `Ctrl+Shift+D` |
| `SplitVertical` | **Split pane down** — Split the focused pane into two, one above the other | `⌘⇧D` | `Ctrl+Shift+E` |
| `Split(left)` | **Split pane left** — Split the focused pane; the new pane goes on the left | — | — |
| `Split(up)` | **Split pane up** — Split the focused pane; the new pane goes above | — | — |
| `ClosePane` | **Close pane** — Close the focused pane; the last pane of a tab closes the tab | — | — |
| `TogglePaneZoom` | **Toggle pane zoom** — Show the focused pane full-size, or restore the layout | — | — |
| `RotatePanes` | **Rotate panes** — Rotate the positions of the panes in the tab | — | — |
| `ActivatePaneDirection(left)` | **Focus pane left** — Move focus to the pane left of the focused one | `⌘⌥←` | `Ctrl+Alt+Left` |
| `ActivatePaneDirection(right)` | **Focus pane right** — Move focus to the pane right of the focused one | `⌘⌥→` | `Ctrl+Alt+Right` |
| `ActivatePaneDirection(up)` | **Focus pane up** — Move focus to the pane up of the focused one | `⌘⌥↑` | `Ctrl+Alt+Up` |
| `ActivatePaneDirection(down)` | **Focus pane down** — Move focus to the pane down of the focused one | `⌘⌥↓` | `Ctrl+Alt+Down` |
| `SwapPane(left)` | **Swap pane left** — Swap the focused pane with its neighbour to the left | — | — |
| `SwapPane(right)` | **Swap pane right** — Swap the focused pane with its neighbour to the right | — | — |
| `SwapPane(up)` | **Swap pane up** — Swap the focused pane with its neighbour to the up | — | — |
| `SwapPane(down)` | **Swap pane down** — Swap the focused pane with its neighbour to the down | — | — |
| `ResizePane(left,5)` | **Resize pane left** — Move the focused pane's left border by 5 cells | — | — |
| `ResizePane(right,5)` | **Resize pane right** — Move the focused pane's right border by 5 cells | — | — |
| `ResizePane(up,5)` | **Resize pane up** — Move the focused pane's up border by 5 cells | — | — |
| `ResizePane(down,5)` | **Resize pane down** — Move the focused pane's down border by 5 cells | — | — |
| `Split` | **Split pane** — Split the focused pane toward `left`, `right`, `up` or `down`; the new pane takes focus | — | — |

## Clipboard & scroll

| Action | Description | macOS | Linux |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Copy` | **Copy** — Copy the selection | `⌘C` | `Ctrl+Shift+C` |
| `Paste` | **Paste** — Paste from the clipboard | `⌘V` | `Ctrl+Shift+V` |
| `SelectAll` | **Select all** — Select the whole screen and scrollback | `⌘A` | `Ctrl+Shift+A` |
| `PastePrimary` | **Paste primary selection** — Paste the Linux primary selection (middle-click buffer) | — | — |
| `ClearScrollback` | **Clear scrollback** — Erase the scrollback buffer | `⌘K` | `Ctrl+Shift+K` |
| `ScrollByPage(-1)` | **Scroll page up** — Scroll the terminal one page towards older output | `⇧PageUp` | `Shift+PageUp` |
| `ScrollByPage(1)` | **Scroll page down** — Scroll the terminal one page towards newer output | `⇧PageDown` | `Shift+PageDown` |
| `ScrollByLine(-1)` | **Scroll line up** — Scroll the terminal one line towards older output | — | — |
| `ScrollByLine(1)` | **Scroll line down** — Scroll the terminal one line towards newer output | — | — |
| `ScrollToPrompt(-1)` | **Scroll to previous prompt** — Jump to the previous shell prompt (needs OSC 133 shell integration) | — | — |
| `ScrollToPrompt(1)` | **Scroll to next prompt** — Jump to the next shell prompt (needs OSC 133 shell integration) | — | — |
| `ScrollToTop` | **Scroll to top** — Jump to the oldest scrollback line | `⇧Home` | `Shift+Home` |
| `ScrollToBottom` | **Scroll to bottom** — Jump back to the live screen | `⇧End` | `Shift+End` |
| `ResetTerminal` | **Reset terminal** — Reset modes, charsets, cursor and tab stops of the focused pane (scrollback is kept) | — | — |
| `OpenLinkAtMouse` | **Open link at mouse cursor** — Open the hyperlink under the last pointer position | — | — |
